subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should this issue continue as a narrow local-avatar diagnostics/security-boundary item after closing or rejecting the conflicting fork PR, or should maintainers adopt that fork PR as the implementation path?
rationale: The central valid-local-avatar behavior is already covered in current source and the latest release, but deciding whether to change raw endpoint behavior, UI diagnostics, or remote/avatar policy affects security boundaries and the open closing PR cannot be resolved by automation safely.

options.title: Reject fork PR and narrow diagnostics
options.body: Close or reject the conflicting fork PR unless it proves a current <=2 MB local-avatar regression, then keep any follow-up limited to user-facing diagnostics while preserving the current file-serving and CSP policy.

options.title: Adopt fork PR after proof
options.body: Review the fork PR only if maintainers want its path-normalization/backtick parsing changes, and require a clean rebase, live Windows proof, and security review first.

options.title: Close after maintainer confirmation
options.body: If maintainers confirm the shipped local-avatar behavior and current diagnostics are sufficient, close this issue with the release/source evidence and direct remote-avatar concerns to the canonical thread.

recommendation.title: Reject fork PR and narrow diagnostics
recommendation.body: Close or reject the conflicting fork PR unless it proves a current <=2 MB local-avatar regression, then keep any follow-up limited to user-facing diagnostics while preserving the current file-serving and CSP policy.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest history signal for avatar support, Control UI route hardening, and the security policy around local avatar serving.
